name: pey.speech
description: Device speech recognition as a platform capability behind a swappable environment adapter (Web Speech API today): support check, microphone permission, start/stop listening with partial and final results. Interprets nothing — transcription meaning belongs to the caller.

provides.name: pey.speech.service
provides.description: Speech-to-text through the device's own recognizer. Recognized text and audio never appear in events, errors or logs — results travel only through the caller's handlers. One listening session exists at a time. Listening follows the shared flow pattern: the caller hands in result handlers and receives a handle with stop() (finish and deliver), cancel() (stop without a result) and a done promise that resolves exactly one of three endings — completed (with the final text, when any), interrupted (with a standard structured error), or cancelled (no result). An unsupported environment is a detectable error, never a crash.

methods.name: getSupport
methods.description: Reports whether speech recognition works in this environment and, when the system says so, whether processing happens on the device or in the cloud ('local' | 'cloud'), or 'unknown' when it cannot be told.

methods.name: requestPermission
methods.description: Asks for the microphone/speech permission explicitly (never at startup) and reports the outcome.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts one listening session in the given language (the configured default otherwise): partial transcriptions while the user speaks and the final transcription when a phrase settles. A second session while one is active is rejected. Long silence ends the session on the device's own terms and surfaces as interrupted with the no-speech code.

params.name: handlers
params.type: { onPartial: (text: string) => void, onFinal: (text: string) => void }

methods.returns: Promise<{ stop: () => void, cancel: () => void, done: Promise<{ ending: 'completed', text: string | null } | { ending: 'interrupted', error: object } | { ending: 'cancelled' }> }>

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Finishes the active session and delivers the result: the ending is completed with the last final transcription, or cancelled when nothing was recognized.

events.name: speech:listening-started
events.description: Published when a listening session actually started. Carries no data.

events.name: speech:listening-stopped
events.description: Published when a listening session ended, for any reason. Carries no data.
